body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). Five test files in plugins/adlc-pi/test/ (classifier-single-source.test.mjs, compaction.test.mjs, evidence-custom-tools.test.mjs, phase4c.test.mjs, widget-wiring.test.mjs) manually invoke mkdtempSync across 10 calls and guard removals in 37 try/finally blocks, and are allowlisted in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs. With @adlc/core/test-kit (tmp), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via t.after when passed the test context t.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In plugins/adlc-pi/test/classifier-single-source.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update tests to accept t and replace mkdtempSync with tmp(t, 'pi-class-ss-').
   - Remove manual try/finally blocks, unindenting test bodies.
2. In plugins/adlc-pi/test/compaction.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update tests to accept t and replace mkdtempSync with tmp(t, 'pi-compact-').
   - Remove manual try/finally blocks, unindenting test bodies.
3. In plugins/adlc-pi/test/evidence-custom-tools.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update tests to accept t and replace mkdtempSync with tmp(t, 'pi-evid-ct-').
   - Remove manual try/finally blocks, unindenting test bodies.
4. In plugins/adlc-pi/test/phase4c.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update tests to accept t and replace mkdtempSync with tmp(t, 'pi-phase4c-').
   - Remove manual try/finally blocks, unindenting test bodies.
5. In plugins/adlc-pi/test/widget-wiring.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update tests to accept t and replace mkdtempSync with tmp(t, 'pi-ww-').
   - Remove manual try/finally blocks, unindenting test bodies.
6. In scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs:
   - Remove plugins/adlc-pi/test/classifier-single-source.test.mjs, plugins/adlc-pi/test/compaction.test.mjs, plugins/adlc-pi/test/evidence-custom-tools.test.mjs, plugins/adlc-pi/test/phase4c.test.mjs, and plugins/adlc-pi/test/widget-wiring.test.mjs from the ALLOWLIST set (completely eradicating plugins/adlc-pi and the entire plugins/ directory from the allowlist!).
7. Verification:
   - node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/classifier-single-source.test.mjs plugins/adlc-pi/test/compaction.test.mjs plugins/adlc-pi/test/evidence-custom-tools.test.mjs plugins/adlc-pi/test/phase4c.test.mjs plugins/adlc-pi/test/widget-wiring.test.mjs exits 0.
   - node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 All 5 test files contain 0 finally blocks.
- AC2 mkdtempSync is not called in any of the 5 test files.
- AC3 None of the 5 test files appear in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs ALLOWLIST.
- AC4 All tests in the 5 files pass cleanly under node --test.
- AC5 node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC6 adlc rails-guard exits 0.
title: refactor(adlc-pi): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate 37 try/finally blocks in features and UI tests
